appearance._comment: Set from the page (Appearance). `style` is the whole posture of the page - workroom | print | softbrut | midcentury | manual | bauhaus; the accent/base/font/dots pick the colours and faces inside it.

week._comment: The fixed skeleton of your week — classes, work hours, standing commitments. /today plans around it. Leave unknowns empty; never guess.

news._comment: The News tab's briefing, built by brain/tools/news.py - RSS and the Hacker News API from this hand-chosen list, never sources it found on its own. `interests` is what you want surfaced, in priority order; an earlier topic claims a story first. Add one with `python3 brain/tools/news.py add "topic"`, or ask Claude. A feed says where it may land: `topic` is exclusive, `topics` is a permission list the keywords choose within, and a feed with neither travels by keyword alone. Per interest: `count` overrides per_topic, `fresh_hours` widens the window for a slow subject, `per_outlet` stops one wire crowding out the rest, and `explain: true` adds a once-a-day plain-language breakdown (a Haiku-sized call, cents) for a field you are learning; the Usage page's News breakdowns switch (`ai_features.news`) turns those off without losing the briefing. The Guardian upgrades from RSS to full excerpts once you store a free key: `python3 brain/tools/news.py guardian KEY`.

night._comment: The night shift: heavy jobs run while you sleep, so they never compete with your day for the same five-hour usage window. 01:00 is deliberate - that window closes at 06:00, before the 07:00 morning plan opens a fresh one. Install with 'Set Up Night Shift (Windows).bat', or `zsh brain/tools/setup_night.sh` on a Mac, then turn it on from the page.

people._comment: How many days after someone's message counts as owing them a reply. Their message showing as unanswered past this fuse is what puts them on the Today card.

_private_comment: Files the scheduled runs (night shift, morning) never load — enforced by brain/tools/private_gate.py. The journal is the default; [] switches it off. Attended sessions are never filtered.

llm._comment: Where the small no-tool jobs run (revise = draft rewording, name = conversation naming). provider: claude | ollama. Ollama needs a model name (e.g. llama3.2) and falls back to Claude whenever it can't answer. The heavy runs always stay Claude.
